## Problem

What cannot be done today, and which module it belongs to (`tasks`, `verifiers`, `forecast`, `train`, `theory`, a pilot).

## Proposal

The behaviour you want. If it changes a rate, a forecast, or a gate, name the check that should verify it (`docs/theory.md` lists the existing ones).

## Alternatives considered

Other designs you weighed, and why you prefer this one.
